knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Gloves do not replace hand hygiene; cleaning is still needed when gloves are worn.
Visible soil calls for soap and water, because a rub does not replace washing in that case.
Before touching a person is a named moment; the other two options are not part of the model.

practicalCriteria: During a supervised personal-care visit, the learner cleans hands at each observed moment, and the assessor records each moment as met or missed
Given a scenario with dirty hands, the learner chooses soap and water and states why
The learner records one missed moment from the observation and proposes a fix
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation record for the visit
stopWorkCriteria: Stop the task and clean hands before any further contact if a moment is missed
Stop use of a rub on dirty hands
